text:
### 3. Account Balance Issues  
**Example:** Missing credit, wrong balance shown, interest miscalculated  
**Investigation:**
- Reconcile transactions
- Check system records
- Verify calculations
- Review any hold periods  
**Resolution:**
- If bank error: Correct balance + interest on missing amount
- If customer misunderstanding: Explain (educate, don't penalize)
- If system error: Urgent IT escalation to fix
name: Chunk 18/38

raw_entities.name: Account Balance Discrepancy
raw_entities.description: A risk category covering situations where customer account balances are incorrect, credits are missing, or interest calculations are wrong. This includes discrepancies arising from bank errors, customer misunderstanding, or system failures.
context: Missing credit, wrong balance shown, interest miscalculated
If bank error: Correct balance + interest on missing amount
If system error: Urgent IT escalation to fix

raw_entities.name: Transaction Reconciliation Requirement
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to reconcile all transactions on an account when investigating balance discrepancies. This is part of the investigation process to identify the root cause of balance issues.
context: Reconcile transactions
Investigation: Reconcile transactions, Check system records, Verify calculations

raw_entities.name: System Records Verification
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to check and verify system records when investigating account balance issues. This ensures that recorded transactions match actual system data.
context: Check system records
Investigation: Reconcile transactions, Check system records, Verify calculations

raw_entities.name: Calculation Verification
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to verify all calculations, particularly interest calculations, when investigating account balance discrepancies.
context: Verify calculations
Investigation: Reconcile transactions, Check system records, Verify calculations

raw_entities.name: Hold Period Review
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to review any hold periods on funds when investigating account balance issues, as holds may explain apparent missing credits.
context: Review any hold periods
Investigation: Reconcile transactions, Check system records, Verify calculations, Review any hold periods

raw_entities.name: Bank Error Balance Correction
raw_entities.description: An obligation to correct the account balance and pay interest on any missing amount when the investigation determines that a bank error caused the discrepancy.
context: If bank error: Correct balance + interest on missing amount

raw_entities.name: Customer Education on Balance Issues
raw_entities.description: An obligation to educate and explain balance discrepancies to customers when the issue results from customer misunderstanding, without imposing penalties.
context: If customer misunderstanding: Explain (educate, don't penalize)

raw_entities.name: System Error IT Escalation
raw_entities.description: An obligation to escalate system errors urgently to the IT department for immediate remediation when a system error is identified as the cause of a balance discrepancy.
context: If system error: Urgent IT escalation to fix

raw_entities.name: Transaction Reconciliation Process
raw_entities.description: A control measure requiring reconciliation of transactions to identify discrepancies and verify account accuracy during balance issue investigations.
context: Reconcile transactions
Investigation: Reconcile transactions, Check system records, Verify calculations

raw_entities.name: System Records Audit
raw_entities.description: A control measure requiring verification of system records to ensure that recorded transactions and balances are accurate and complete.
context: Check system records
Investigation: Reconcile transactions, Check system records, Verify calculations

raw_entities.name: Calculation Verification Control
raw_entities.description: A control measure requiring verification of all calculations, particularly interest calculations, to ensure mathematical accuracy in account balances.
context: Verify calculations
Investigation: Reconcile transactions, Check system records, Verify calculations
